definition: the act of an army entering another country by force in order to take control of it
example: the German invasion of Poland in 1939
definition_zh: 指一支军队为控制他国而武力入侵该国的行为
example_zh: 1939年德国入侵波兰

definition: an official examination of the facts about a situation, crime, etc.
example: a criminal/murder/police investigation
definition_zh: 对某一情况、犯罪等事实进行的正式调查。
example_zh: 犯罪/谋杀/警方调查

definition: the act of investing money in something
example: foreign/private investment
definition_zh: 将资金投入某事的行为
example_zh: 外资/私人投资

definition: a person or an organization that invests money in something
example: small investors (= private people)
definition_zh: 向某事物投资资金的个人或组织
example_zh: 小投资者（即个人投资者）

definition: to separate somebody/something physically or socially from other people or things
example: isolate somebody/yourself/something, Patients with the disease should be isolated.
definition_zh: 将某人或某物在物理上或社交上与其他人或事物隔离开来
example_zh: 隔离某人/自己/某物，患有该疾病的患者应予以隔离。

definition: far away from any others
example: isolated rural areas
definition_zh: 远离其他一切
example_zh: 偏远农村地区

definition: to make something known formally
example: issue something, They issued a joint statement denying the charges.
definition_zh: 正式公布某事
example_zh: 发布某项声明，他们发表了一份联合声明，否认了这些指控。

definition: a prison
example: She spent a year in jail.
definition_zh: 一座监狱
example_zh: 她在监狱里待了一年。

definition: to put somebody in prison
example: be jailed (for something), He was jailed for life for murder.
definition_zh: 将某人送进监狱
example_zh: 因……入狱，他因谋杀罪被判处无期徒刑。

definition: a plane driven by jet engines
example: a jet aircraft/fighter/airliner
definition_zh: 一架由喷气发动机驱动的飞机
example_zh: 喷气式飞机/战斗机/客机

definition: involving two or more people together
example: a joint account (= a bank account in the name of more than one person, for example shared by a couple)
definition_zh: 涉及两人或两人以上共同参与
example_zh: 联名账户（即以两人以上名义开设的银行账户，例如夫妻共同持有的账户）

definition: a place where two bones are joined together in the body in a way that enables them to bend and move
example: inflammation of the knee joint
definition_zh: 人体中两块骨头连接在一起，使其能够弯曲和活动的地方
example_zh: 膝关节炎症

definition: the work of collecting and writing news stories for newspapers, magazines, radio, television or online news sites; the news stories that are written
example: I'd like a career in journalism.
definition_zh: 为报纸、杂志、广播、电视或在线新闻网站收集和撰写新闻报道的工作；所撰写的新闻报道
example_zh: 我想从事新闻工作。

definition: a feeling of great happiness
example: Her books have brought joy to millions.
definition_zh: 一种极大的幸福感
example_zh: 她的书给数百万读者带来了欢乐。

definition: the ability to make sensible decisions after carefully considering the best thing to do
example: good/poor/sound judgement
definition_zh: 在仔细权衡最佳方案后，做出明智决定的能力
example_zh: 良好/差/明智的判断

definition: having a low rank in an organization or a profession
example: a junior partner/minister/officer
definition_zh: 在某个组织或职业中地位较低
example_zh: 初级合伙人/部长/官员

definition: a group of members of the public who listen to the facts of a case in a court and decide whether or not somebody is guilty of a crime, or whether a claim has been proved
example: members of the jury
definition_zh: 一群在法庭上听取案件事实、并裁定某人是否犯有罪行或某项主张是否已得到证实的公众成员
example_zh: 陪审团成员

definition: the fair treatment of people
example: She spent her life fighting for social justice and equality for women.
definition_zh: 对人的公平对待
example_zh: 她毕生致力于为社会正义和妇女平等而奋斗。

definition: to show that somebody/something is right or reasonable
example: justify doing something, How can they justify paying such huge salaries?
definition_zh: 为了证明某人或某事是正确的或合理的
example_zh: 为某事辩解，他们怎么能为支付如此高昂的薪水辩解呢？

definition: a set of tools or equipment that you use for a particular purpose
example: a first-aid kit
definition_zh: 用于特定目的的一套工具或设备
example_zh: 急救包

definition: work, especially physical work
example: manual labour (= work using your hands)
definition_zh: 工作，尤其是体力劳动
example_zh: 体力劳动（即用手进行的工作）

definition: a piece of equipment for climbing up and down a wall, the side of a building, etc., consisting of two lengths of wood or metal that are joined together by steps or rungs
example: to climb up/fall off a ladder
definition_zh: 一种用于攀爬或下墙、建筑物外墙等的设备，由两根木条或金属条组成，其间通过台阶或横档连接而成
example_zh: 爬上/从梯子上摔下来

definition: an act of bringing an aircraft or a spacecraft down to the ground after a journey
example: a perfect/smooth/safe landing
definition_zh: 指飞行器或航天器在完成飞行后降落至地面的过程
example_zh: 一次完美/平稳/安全的着陆

definition: everything you can see when you look across a large area of land, especially in the country
example: the woods and fields that are typical features of the English landscape
definition_zh: 放眼望去，在广阔的土地上所能看到的一切，尤其是在乡下
example_zh: 作为英格兰风景典型特征的树林和田野

definition: a narrow road in the country
example: winding country lanes
definition_zh: 乡间的一条狭窄小路
example_zh: 蜿蜒的乡村小路

definition: to a great extent; mostly or mainly
example: The manager was largely responsible for the team’s victory.
definition_zh: 在很大程度上；大多或主要是
example_zh: 这支球队的胜利主要归功于主教练。

definition: recently; in the recent past
example: Have you seen her lately?
definition_zh: 最近；在不久前
example_zh: 最近见过她吗？

definition: the most recent or the newest thing or piece of news
example: the latest (in something), This is the latest in robot technology.
definition_zh: 最新或最前期的事情或新闻
example_zh: （某领域的）最新，这是机器人技术的最新成果。

definition: the action of launching something
example: a missile/rocket launch
definition_zh: 发射某物的动作
example_zh: 导弹/火箭发射

definition: to start an activity, especially an organized one
example: The government recently launched a national road safety campaign.
definition_zh: 开展一项活动，尤其是有组织的活动
example_zh: 政府最近发起了一项全国性的道路安全宣传活动。

definition: the state or position of being a leader
example: a leadership role/position
definition_zh: 作为领导者的状态或地位
example_zh: 领导角色/职位

definition: a printed sheet of paper or a few printed pages that are given free to advertise or give information about something
example: We picked up a few leaflets on local places of interest.
definition_zh: 一张或几张印有文字的纸张，免费分发以宣传或提供有关某事的信息
example_zh: 我们拿了几份关于当地景点的小册子。

definition: a group of sports teams who all play each other to earn points and find which team is best
example: Castleford have led the league for most of the season.
definition_zh: 由多支运动队组成的一组，这些队伍相互比赛以获得积分，并决出哪支队伍最强
example_zh: 卡斯尔福德在本赛季的大部分时间里都领跑联赛。

definition: to bend or move from a straight position to a sloping position
example: I leaned back in my chair.
definition_zh: 从笔直的状态弯曲或移动到倾斜的状态
example_zh: 我向后靠在椅子上。

definition: a period of time when you are allowed to be away from work for a holiday or for a special reason
example: to take a month’s paid/unpaid leave
definition_zh: 因休假或特殊原因而获准暂时离开工作岗位的一段时间
example_zh: 休一个月带薪/无薪假

definition: a story from ancient times about people and events, that may or may not be true; this type of story
example: The film is based on the legend of Robin Hood.
definition_zh: 一个关于古时人物和事件的故事，其真实性尚无定论；这类故事
example_zh: 这部电影改编自罗宾汉的传说。

definition: a curved piece of glass or plastic that makes things look larger, smaller or clearer when you look through it
example: a pair of glasses with tinted lenses
definition_zh: 一块弯曲的玻璃或塑料片，透过它看，物体会显得更大、更小或更清晰
example_zh: 一副带色镜片的眼镜

definition: to make something flat or smooth
example: level something out, The first coat of plaster levels out the surface of the wall.
definition_zh: 使某物变得平整或光滑
example_zh: 将某物抹平，第一层石膏可将墙面抹平。

definition: an official document that shows that permission has been given to do, own or use something
example: Applicants must hold a valid driving licence.
definition_zh: 一份证明已获准从事、拥有或使用某事的官方文件
example_zh: 申请人必须持有有效的驾驶证。

definition: the length of time that somebody lives or that something lasts
example: a lifetime of experience
definition_zh: 某人活着的时间长度，或某物持续的时间长度
example_zh: 一生的经验

definition: the arrangement or type of light in a place
example: electric/natural lighting
definition_zh: 某处灯光的布置或类型
example_zh: 人工照明/自然采光

definition: the same; in a similar way
example: He voted for the change and he expected his colleagues to do likewise.
definition_zh: 一样；以类似的方式
example_zh: 他投票支持这项变更，并希望他的同事们也能这样做。

definition: the act or process of limiting or controlling somebody/something
example: They would resist any limitation of their powers.
definition_zh: 限制或控制某人/某事的行为或过程
example_zh: 他们会抵制任何对其权力的限制。

definition: not very great in amount or extent
example: We are doing our best with the limited resources available.
definition_zh: 数量或范围都不大
example_zh: 在现有有限资源的条件下，我们正在尽最大努力。

definition: to cover the inside of something with a layer of another material, especially to keep it clean or make it stronger
example: Butter and line a 25 cm cake tin.
definition_zh: 用另一层材料覆盖某物的内侧，尤其是为了保持其清洁或增强其强度
example_zh: 在25厘米的蛋糕模具内涂抹黄油并铺上烘焙纸。

definition: in a literal way
example: The word ‘planet’ literally means ‘wandering body’.
definition_zh: 从字面意义上说
example_zh: “行星”一词的字面意思是“游移的天体”。

definition: connected with literature
example: literary criticism/theory
definition_zh: 与文学有关
example_zh: 文学批评/理论

definition: a unit for measuring volume, equal to 1.76 British pints or 2.11 American pints
example: 3 litres of water
definition_zh: 一种体积单位，等于1.76英制品脱或2.11美制品脱
example_zh: 3升水

definition: small pieces of rubbish such as paper, cans and bottles, that people have left lying in a public place
example: There will be fines for people who drop litter.
definition_zh: 人们随意丢弃在公共场所的小块垃圾，例如纸张、易拉罐和瓶子等
example_zh: 乱扔垃圾者将被处以罚款。

definition: full of life and energy; active and enthusiastic
example: an intelligent and lively young woman
definition_zh: 充满活力和朝气；积极向上、热情洋溢
example_zh: 一位聪明活泼的年轻女子

definition: something that is being carried (usually in large amounts) by a person, vehicle, etc.
example: The trucks waited at the warehouse to pick up their loads.
definition_zh: 由人、车辆等（通常是大量）所运载的物品。
example_zh: 卡车们在仓库里等待装货。

definition: to put a large quantity of things or people onto or into something
example: load something, We loaded the car in ten minutes.
definition_zh: 将大量物品或人放进或装进某物中
example_zh: 装点东西，我们十分钟就装好了车。

definition: money that an organization such as a bank lends and somebody borrows
example: to take out/repay a loan (= to borrow money/pay it back)
definition_zh: 银行等机构放贷、某人借入的资金
example_zh: 申请/偿还贷款（= 借钱/还钱）

definition: seeming natural, reasonable or sensible
example: It was a logical conclusion from the child's point of view.
definition_zh: 看起来自然、合理或合情合理
example_zh: 从孩子的角度来看，这是一个合乎逻辑的结论。

definition: a printed design or symbol that a company or an organization uses as its special sign
example: All over the world there are red and white paper cups bearing the company logo.
definition_zh: 公司或组织用作其专属标志的印刷图案或符号
example_zh: 世界各地都能看到印有该公司标志的红白相间的纸杯。

definition: lasting or having an effect over a long period of time
example: Our long-term goal is to lower operating costs by 10 per cent.
definition_zh: 持久的，或其影响持续较长时间的
example_zh: 我们的长期目标是将运营成本降低10%。

definition: over a long period of time
example: to benefit/affect somebody long-term
definition_zh: 在相当长的一段时间内
example_zh: 对某人产生长期的益处/影响

definition: not securely fixed where it should be; able to become separated from something
example: a loose button/tooth
definition_zh: 未在应有的位置牢固固定；可能与某物脱离
example_zh: 一颗松动的纽扣/牙齿

definition: (in the UK) a man of high rank in the nobility (= people of high social class), or somebody who has been given the title ‘lord’ as an honour
example: She's married to a lord.
definition_zh: （在英国）贵族阶层中地位显赫的人（即社会地位较高的人），或因受封而获“勋爵”头衔的人
example_zh: 她嫁给了一位男爵。

definition: a way of raising money for a government, charity, etc. by selling tickets that have different numbers on them that people have chosen. Numbers are then chosen by chance and the people who have those numbers on their tickets win prizes.
example: the national/state lottery
definition_zh: 一种为政府、慈善机构等筹集资金的方式，即出售印有不同号码的彩票，这些号码由参与者自行选择。随后通过随机抽取号码，持有中奖号码的彩票持有者即可获得奖品。
example_zh: 国家/州彩票

definition: a low level or point; a low figure
example: The temperature reached a record low in London last night.
definition_zh: 较低的水平或点位；较低的数值
example_zh: 昨晚伦敦的气温创下了历史新低。

definition: to reduce something or to become less in value, quality, etc.
example: lower something, He lowered his voice to a whisper.
definition_zh: 指某物减少，或其价值、质量等降低。
example_zh: “把……放低一点”，他压低了声音，轻声说道。

definition: remaining constant in your support of somebody/something
example: a loyal friend/supporter
definition_zh: 始终如一地支持某人/某事
example_zh: 一位忠实的朋友/支持者

definition: either of the two organs in the chest that you use for breathing
example: Her father died of lung cancer.
definition_zh: 胸腔内用于呼吸的两个器官中的任何一个
example_zh: 她的父亲死于肺癌。

definition: the words of a popular song
example: music and lyrics by Rodgers and Hart
definition_zh: 一首流行歌曲的歌词
example_zh: 曲词均由罗杰斯和哈特创作

definition: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise
example: The Taj Mahal is a magnificent building.
definition_zh: 极具吸引力且令人印象深刻；值得称赞
example_zh: 泰姬陵是一座宏伟的建筑。

definition: to make something continue at the same level, standard, etc.
example: to maintain law and order/standards/a balance/control
definition_zh: 使某事保持在同一水平、标准等。
example_zh: 以维护法律和秩序/标准/平衡/控制

definition: the largest part of a group of people or things
example: majority (of somebody/something), The majority of people interviewed prefer TV to radio.
definition_zh: 一群人或事物中占最大比例的部分
example_zh: （某人/某事）的大多数，接受采访的大多数人更喜欢看电视而不是听广播。

definition: the name or type of a machine, piece of equipment, etc. that is made by a particular company
example: make of something, What make of car does he drive?
definition_zh: 由某家公司制造的机器、设备等的名称或类型
example_zh: 某款车，他开的是什么牌子的车？

definition: coloured substances used on the skin to make yourself look more attractive or to change your appearance
example: eye make-up
definition_zh: 涂抹在皮肤上的有色物质，用于让自己看起来更吸引人或改变外貌
example_zh: 眼妆

definition: the act or process of making or producing something
example: strategic decision-making
definition_zh: 制造或生产某物的行为或过程
example_zh: 战略决策

definition: to make goods in large quantities, using machines
example: manufactured goods
definition_zh: 利用机器大量生产商品
example_zh: 制成品

definition: the business or industry of producing goods in large quantities in factories, etc.
example: Many jobs in manufacturing were lost during the recession.
definition_zh: 在工厂等场所大量生产商品的商业或行业。
example_zh: 经济衰退期间，制造业失去了许多工作岗位。

definition: to make a map of an area
example: an unexplored region that has not yet been mapped
definition_zh: 绘制某地区的地图
example_zh: 一片尚未被勘探且尚未绘制地图的地区

definition: a long running race of about 42 kilometres or 26 miles
example: the London marathon
definition_zh: 一项长跑比赛，赛程约为42公里或26英里
example_zh: 伦敦马拉松

definition: the empty space at the side of a written or printed page
example: the left-hand/right-hand margin
definition_zh: 书写或印刷页面侧边的空白处
example_zh: 左边距/右边距

definition: an object or a sign that shows the position of something
example: a boundary marker
definition_zh: 一个物体或符号，用于指示某物的位置
example_zh: 界标

definition: connected with fighting or war
example: She has practised martial arts for several years.
definition_zh: 与战斗或战争有关的
example_zh: 她练武已有几年了。

definition: affecting or involving a large number of people or things
example: The world faces the tremendous problem of mass unemployment.
definition_zh: 影响或涉及大量人员或事物
example_zh: 世界正面临着大规模失业这一严峻问题。

definition: a large amount of a substance that does not have a definite shape or form
example: She saw a large dark mass in the water.
definition_zh: 大量没有固定形状或形态的物质
example_zh: 她看到水里有一个巨大的黑色物体。

definition: very large, heavy and solid
example: a massive rock
definition_zh: 非常大、重且结实
example_zh: 一块巨大的岩石

definition: a man who has people working for him, often as servants in his home
example: They lived in fear of their master.
definition_zh: 指手下有仆人的人，这些仆人通常在他家中服侍他
example_zh: 他们一直活在对主人的恐惧之中。

definition: to learn or understand something completely
example: She never completely mastered the art of lip-reading.
definition_zh: 彻底掌握或理解某事
example_zh: 她从未完全掌握读唇术。

definition: having the same colour, pattern, style, etc. and therefore looking attractive together
example: The two sisters wore matching outfits.
definition_zh: 颜色、图案、款式等相同，因此搭配起来很赏心悦目
example_zh: 这两姐妹穿了同款衣服。

definition: a friend
example: They've been best mates since school.
definition_zh: 一位朋友
example_zh: 他们从上学起就是最好的朋友。

definition: to have sex in order to produce young
example: Do foxes ever mate with dogs?
definition_zh: 为了繁衍后代而发生性行为
example_zh: 狐狸会和狗交配吗？

definition: connected with money, possessions, etc. rather than with the needs of the mind or spirit
example: material possessions/wealth
definition_zh: 与金钱、财产等有关，而非与思想或精神上的需求有关
example_zh: 物质财富

definition: as large, fast, etc. as is possible, or the most that is possible or allowed
example: the maximum amount/number of something
definition_zh: 尽可能大、尽可能快等，或达到可能或允许的最大程度
example_zh: 某事物的最大数量/数量上限

definition: the greatest amount, size, speed, etc. that is possible, recorded or allowed
example: a maximum of 30 children in a class
definition_zh: 可能达到、有记录或允许的最大数量、尺寸、速度等
example_zh: 每班最多30名儿童

definition: the head of the government of a town or city, etc., elected by the public
example: the Mayor of New York
definition_zh: 由公众选举产生的城镇等行政区域的政府首脑
example_zh: 纽约市长

definition: an action, an object or a system by which a result is achieved; a way of achieving or doing something
example: means of something, Email is a highly effective means of communication.
definition_zh: 一种通过某种行动、对象或系统来实现某种结果的方式；实现或完成某事的方法
example_zh: 某种方式，电子邮件是一种非常有效的沟通方式。

definition: the act or the process of finding the size, quantity or degree of something
example: the metric system of measurement
definition_zh: 确定某事物尺寸、数量或程度的行为或过程
example_zh: 公制单位

definition: a person whose job is repairing machines, especially the engines of vehicles
example: a car/motor mechanic
definition_zh: 从事机器维修工作的人，尤其是车辆发动机的维修
example_zh: 汽车/摩托车修理工

definition: operated by power from an engine
example: a mechanical device/toy/clock
definition_zh: 由发动机提供动力驱动
example_zh: 一种机械装置/玩具/钟表

definition: a set of moving parts in a machine that performs a task
example: a delicate watch mechanism
definition_zh: 机器中执行某项任务的一组运动部件
example_zh: 精密的钟表机芯

definition: a flat piece of metal, usually like a coin in shape, that is given to the winner of a competition or to somebody who has been brave, for example in war
example: to win a gold medal in the Olympics
definition_zh: 一块扁平的金属片，通常呈硬币状，颁发给比赛的获胜者或表现勇敢的人，例如在战争中
example_zh: 在奥运会上夺得金牌

definition: a drug or another form of medicine that you take to prevent or to treat an illness; treatment involving drugs
example: Are you currently taking any medication?
definition_zh: 一种药物或另一种形式的药物，用于预防或治疗疾病；涉及药物治疗的疗法
example_zh: 您目前正在服用任何药物吗？

definition: a way of communicating information, etc. to people
example: the medium of radio/television
definition_zh: 向人们传达信息等的一种方式
example_zh: 广播/电视这一媒介

definition: to become or make something become liquid as a result of heating
example: The snow showed no sign of melting.
definition_zh: 因加热而使某物变成液体或使某物液化
example_zh: 积雪丝毫没有融化的迹象。

definition: the state of being a member of a group, a club, an organization, etc.
example: membership of something, (British English), Who is eligible to apply for membership of the association?
definition_zh: 作为某个团体、俱乐部、组织等成员的状态。
example_zh: 某组织的会员资格（英式英语），谁有资格申请该协会的会员资格？

definition: worth remembering or easy to remember, especially because of being special or unusual
example: The holiday provided many memorable moments.
definition_zh: 值得记住或容易记住的，尤其是因为其独特或不同寻常
example_zh: 这次假期留下了许多难忘的回忆。

definition: a word or phrase used to describe somebody/something else, in a way that is different from its normal use, in order to show that the two things have the same qualities and to make the description more powerful, for example She has a heart of stone; the use of such words and phrases
example: a game of football used as a metaphor for the competitive struggle of life
definition_zh: 指以不同于其通常含义的方式来描述某人或某物，以此表明二者具有相同的特质，并使描述更具感染力；例如“她心如磐石”；此类词语和短语的用法
example_zh: 一场足球比赛，被用作人生竞争与奋斗的隐喻

definition: connected with soldiers or the armed forces
example: We may have to take military action.
definition_zh: 与士兵或武装部队有关的
example_zh: 我们可能不得不采取军事行动。

definition: soldiers; the armed forces
example: The military was/were called in to deal with the riot.
definition_zh: 士兵；武装部队
example_zh: 军方被调遣去平息骚乱。

definition: a person who works in a mine taking out coal, gold, diamonds, etc.
example: Rescuers are trying to save miners trapped underground after a gas explosion.
definition_zh: 在矿井中开采煤炭、黄金、钻石等的人。
example_zh: 在发生气体爆炸后，救援人员正在努力营救被困在地下的矿工。

definition: a substance that is naturally present in the earth and is not formed from animal or vegetable matter, for example gold and salt. Some minerals are also present in food and drink and in the human body and are essential for good health.
example: a country rich in mineral resources
definition_zh: 一种天然存在于地球中、并非由动植物物质形成的物质，例如黄金和盐。某些矿物质也存在于食物、饮料以及人体内，对保持身体健康至关重要。
example_zh: 一个矿产资源丰富的国家

definition: the smallest that is possible or allowed; extremely small
example: a minimum charge/price
definition_zh: 可能或允许的最小值；极其微小
example_zh: 最低收费/价格

definition: the smallest or lowest amount that is possible, required or recorded
example: The class needs a minimum of six students to continue.
definition_zh: 可能的、要求的或记录的最小或最低数值
example_zh: 该课程至少需要六名学生才能继续开课。

definition: a senior member of the government who is in charge of a government department or a branch of one
example: the Minister of Education
definition_zh: 政府中负责某个政府部门或其下属机构的高级官员
example_zh: 教育部长

definition: not very large, important or serious
example: The new plan involves widening a minor road through the valley.
definition_zh: 规模不大、不重要或不严重
example_zh: 新计划包括拓宽一条贯穿山谷的小路。

definition: the smaller part of a group; less than half of the people or things in a large group
example: Only a small minority of students is/are interested in politics these days.
definition_zh: 一个群体中较小的一部分；一个大群体中少于一半的人或事物
example_zh: 如今，只有极少数学生对政治感兴趣。

definition: very unhappy or uncomfortable
example: We were cold, wet and thoroughly miserable.
definition_zh: 非常不高兴或很不舒服
example_zh: 我们又冷又湿，简直糟透了。

definition: an important task that is given to a person or group, especially one involving travel to another country
example: The team was sent on a mission to rescue the hostages.
definition_zh: 指委派给某人或某组人的重要任务，尤其是需要前往另一个国家执行的任务
example_zh: 这支队伍被派去执行一项营救人质的任务。

definition: to not understand or judge somebody/something correctly
example: mistake somebody/something, I admit that I mistook his intentions.
definition_zh: 未能正确理解或评判某人/某事
example_zh: 误解某人/某事，我承认我误解了他的意图。

definition: consisting of different qualities or elements
example: a mixed diet
definition_zh: 由不同的性质或要素组成
example_zh: 混合饮食

definition: a particular way of doing something; a particular type of something
example: a mode of communication
definition_zh: 做某事的一种特定方式；某事物的某种特定类型
example_zh: 一种交流方式

definition: to create a copy or description of an activity, a situation, etc. so that you can study it before dealing with the real thing
example: The program can model a typical home page for you.
definition_zh: 对某项活动、某种情况等进行模拟或描述，以便在处理实际情况之前先进行研究
example_zh: 该程序可以为您生成一个典型的首页模板。

definition: not very large, expensive, important, etc.
example: modest improvements/reforms
definition_zh: 不是很大、很贵、很重要等。
example_zh: 微小的改进/改革

definition: to change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose
example: Patients are taught how to modify their diet.
definition_zh: 对某事稍作改动，尤其是为了使其更适合特定用途
example_zh: 指导患者如何调整饮食。

definition: a screen that shows information from a computer; a television screen used to show particular kinds of information
example: The details of today's flights are displayed on the monitor.
definition_zh: 显示计算机信息的屏幕；用于显示特定类型信息的电视屏幕
example_zh: 今天的航班详情显示在屏幕上。

definition: to watch and check something over a period of time in order to see how it develops, so that you can make any necessary changes
example: monitor something, Each student's progress is closely monitored.
definition_zh: 在一段时间内观察和检查某事，以了解其发展情况，从而做出必要的调整
example_zh: 监控某事，每位学生的学习进展都受到密切监控。

definition: (in stories) an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly and frightening
example: a monster with three heads
definition_zh: （在故事中）一种体型巨大、相貌丑陋且令人恐惧的虚构生物
example_zh: 一只三头怪兽

definition: happening once a month or every month
example: a monthly meeting/visit/magazine
definition_zh: 每月发生一次或每月一次
example_zh: 每月一次的会议/探访/杂志

definition: a building, column, statue, etc. built to remind people of a famous person or event
example: A monument to him was erected in St Paul's Cathedral.
definition_zh: 为纪念某位名人或某件大事而建造的建筑、柱子、雕像等
example_zh: 在圣保罗大教堂为他竖立了一座纪念碑。

definition: connected with principles of right and wrong behaviour
example: a moral issue/dilemma
definition_zh: 与行为的是非原则相关
example_zh: 一个道德问题/道德困境

definition: standards or principles of good behaviour, especially in matters of sexual relationships
example: Young people these days have no morals.
definition_zh: 行为准则或原则，特别是在性关系方面
example_zh: 现在的年轻人毫无道德可言。

definition: used to introduce some new information that adds to or supports what you have said previously
example: A talented artist, he was, moreover, a writer of some note.
definition_zh: 用于引入一些新信息，以补充或支持你之前所说的话
example_zh: 他不仅是一位才华横溢的艺术家，还是一位颇有声望的作家。

definition: a legal agreement by which a bank or similar organization lends you money to buy a house, etc., and you pay the money back over a particular number of years; the sum of money that you borrow
example: to apply for/take out/pay off a mortgage
definition_zh: 一种法律协议，根据该协议，银行或类似机构向您提供贷款用于购房等用途，而您需在特定期限内偿还该笔款项；您所借的这笔款项
example_zh: 申请/办理/还清住房贷款

definition: a building where Muslims go to worship (= praise God)
example: I used to pray at the local mosque with my father and grandfather.
definition_zh: 穆斯林前往礼拜（=赞美真主）的建筑
example_zh: 我以前常和父亲、祖父一起在当地的清真寺做礼拜。

definition: the act or process of moving or the way something moves
example: What was Newton's first law of motion?
definition_zh: 移动的行为或过程，或某物移动的方式
example_zh: 牛顿的第一运动定律是什么？

definition: to be the reason why somebody does something or behaves in a particular way
example: motivate somebody (to do something), What motivates people to carry out such attacks?
definition_zh: 是某人做某事或表现出某种特定行为的原因
example_zh: 激励某人（去做某事），是什么促使人们实施此类袭击？

definition: the reason why somebody does something or behaves in a particular way
example: motivation (behind something), What is the motivation behind this sudden change?
definition_zh: 某人做某事或表现出某种特定行为的原因
example_zh: 动机（某事背后的），这次突然的变化背后有什么动机？

definition: having an engine; using the power of an engine
example: The street is closed to motor vehicles.
definition_zh: 装有发动机；利用发动机的动力
example_zh: 该街道禁止机动车通行。

definition: a device that uses electricity, petrol, etc. to produce movement and makes a machine, a vehicle, a boat, etc. work
example: An electric motor is used to pump the water.
definition_zh: 一种利用电力、汽油等产生动力，并驱动机器、车辆、船只等运行的装置
example_zh: 水泵由电动机驱动。

definition: to organize and begin something
example: Residents mounted a campaign to fight the plans.
definition_zh: 组织并开始某件事
example_zh: 居民们发起了一场运动，反对这些计划。

definition: causing strong, often sad, feelings about somebody/something
example: a deeply moving experience
definition_zh: 引发对某人或某事强烈且往往令人伤感的情感
example_zh: 一次令人深受感动的经历

definition: many in number; involving many different people or things
example: The shape appears multiple times within each painting.
definition_zh: 数量众多；涉及许多不同的人或事物
example_zh: 该形状在每幅画中都多次出现。

definition: to add a number to itself a particular number of times
example: The children are already learning to multiply and divide.
definition_zh: 将一个数与它自身相加特定次数
example_zh: 孩子们已经在学习乘法和除法了。

definition: difficult to understand or explain; strange
example: He died in mysterious circumstances.
definition_zh: 难以理解或解释；奇怪
example_zh: 他死于一场离奇的事件。

definition: a story from ancient times, especially one that was told to explain natural events or to describe the early history of a people; this type of story
example: ancient Greek myths
definition_zh: 古代的故事，尤其是用来解释自然现象或描述某个民族早期历史的故事；这类故事
example_zh: 古希腊神话

definition: not wearing any clothes
example: She was clutching the sheet around her naked body.
definition_zh: 身无寸布
example_zh: 她正用床单裹住自己赤裸的身体。

definition: to become or make something less wide
example: This is where the river narrows.
definition_zh: 使某物变窄或使其宽度减小
example_zh: 河流在这里变窄了。

definition: very bad or unpleasant
example: He had a nasty accident.
definition_zh: 非常糟糕或令人不快
example_zh: 他遭遇了一场严重的事故。

definition: a citizen of a particular country
example: Polish nationals living in Germany
definition_zh: 某国的公民
example_zh: 居住在德国的波兰公民

definition: the skill or the process of planning a route for a ship or other vehicle and taking it there
example: a maker of in-car navigation systems
definition_zh: 为船舶或其他交通工具规划航线并将其驶往该地的技能或过程
example_zh: 一家车载导航系统制造商

definition: near in position; not far away
example: Her mother lived in a nearby town.
definition_zh: 位置相近；距离不远
example_zh: 她母亲住在附近的一个小镇上。

definition: a short distance from somebody/something; not far away
example: They live nearby.
definition_zh: 离某人/某物不远；就在附近
example_zh: 他们就住在附近。

definition: tidy and in order; carefully done or arranged
example: She kept her desk extremely neat.
definition_zh: 整洁有序；处理或安排得十分仔细
example_zh: 她的办公桌总是整理得非常整洁。

definition: the fact that something must happen or be done; the need for something
example: necessity for something, We recognize the necessity for a written agreement.
definition_zh: 某事必须发生或必须做；对某事的必要性
example_zh: 某事的必要性，我们认识到签订书面协议的必要性。

definition: a word or statement that means ‘no’; an act of refusing to do something or of denying something
example: in the negative, She answered in the negative (= said ‘no’).
definition_zh: 表示“不”的词或语句；拒绝做某事或否认某事的举动
example_zh: 她予以否认，她回答说“不”（= 说“不”）。

definition: to try to reach an agreement by formal discussion
example: negotiate (with somebody) (for something), The government will not negotiate with terrorists.
definition_zh: 通过正式磋商试图达成协议
example_zh: （与某人）就（某事）进行谈判，政府不会与恐怖分子进行谈判。

definition: formal discussion between people who are trying to reach an agreement
example: peace/trade/contract negotiations
definition_zh: 试图达成协议的人之间进行的正式讨论
example_zh: 和平/贸易/合同谈判

definition: any of the long fibres that carry messages between the brain and parts of the body, enabling you to move, feel pain, etc.
example: the optic nerve
definition_zh: 任何一种在大脑与身体各部位之间传递信息的长纤维，使你能够活动、感到疼痛等。
example_zh: 视神经

definition: not supporting or helping either side in a disagreement, competition, etc.
example: Journalists are supposed to be politically neutral.
definition_zh: 在争执、竞争等情况下，不支持也不帮助任何一方。
example_zh: 记者理应保持政治中立。

definition: despite something that you have just mentioned
example: There is little chance that we will succeed in changing the law. Nevertheless, it is important that we try.
definition_zh: 尽管你刚才提到了某件事
example_zh: 我们成功修改法律的可能性微乎其微。尽管如此，尝试一下还是很重要的。

definition: recently
example: a newly qualified doctor
definition_zh: 最近
example_zh: 一名刚取得行医资格的医生

definition: a dream that is very frightening or unpleasant
example: He still has nightmares about the accident.
definition_zh: 一个非常可怕或令人不快的梦
example_zh: 他至今仍会因那场事故做噩梦。

definition: a situation or a pattern of behaviour that is usual or expected
example: The new design is a departure from the norm.
definition_zh: 一种常见或可预期的状况或行为模式
example_zh: 新设计与常规设计大相径庭。

definition: a small book of plain paper for writing notes in
example: The police officer wrote the details down in his notebook.
definition_zh: 一本用普通纸印成的、用来记笔记的小本子
example_zh: 那位警察把详情记在了笔记本上。

definition: an idea, a belief or an understanding of something
example: notion of something, a political system based on the notions of equality and liberty
definition_zh: 一种想法、一种信念或对某事的理解
example_zh: 对某事物的观念，一种基于平等与自由理念的政治制度

definition: a person who writes novels
example: a romantic/historical novelist
definition_zh: 写小说的人
example_zh: 一位浪漫主义/历史小说家

definition: at the present time, in contrast with the past
example: Nowadays most kids prefer going online to reading books.
definition_zh: 目前，与过去相比
example_zh: 如今，大多数孩子更喜欢上网，而不是看书。

definition: existing in large numbers
example: He has been late on numerous occasions.
definition_zh: 数量众多
example_zh: 他已经迟到过很多次了。

definition: the job or skill of caring for people who are sick or injured
example: a career in nursing
definition_zh: 照顾生病或受伤者的工作或技能
example_zh: 护理事业

definition: the process by which living things receive the food necessary for them to grow and be healthy
example: advice on diet and nutrition
definition_zh: 生物获取生长和保持健康所需营养的过程
example_zh: 关于饮食和营养的建议

definition: the quality or fact of being very fat, in a way that is not healthy
example: Obesity can increase the risk of heart disease.
definition_zh: 指身体极度肥胖的状态或事实，且这种肥胖对健康有害
example_zh: 肥胖会增加患心脏病的风险。

definition: to do what you are told or expected to do
example: obey something, to obey a command/an order/rules/the law
definition_zh: 按照别人交代或期望的那样去做
example_zh: 服从某事，服从命令/指示/规则/法律

definition: to say that you disagree with or oppose something
example: If nobody objects, we'll postpone the meeting till next week.
definition_zh: 表示你不同意或反对某事
example_zh: 如果没人反对，我们就把会议推迟到下周。

definition: not influenced by personal feelings or opinions; considering only facts
example: an objective assessment of the situation
definition_zh: 不受个人情感或观点的影响；仅考虑事实
example_zh: 对局势的客观评估

definition: something that you are trying to achieve
example: the primary/principal/key objective
definition_zh: 你正在努力实现的目标
example_zh: 首要/主要/核心目标

definition: the state of being forced to do something because it is your duty, or because of a law, etc.
example: obligation to do something, You are under no obligation to buy anything.
definition_zh: 因职责所在或法律规定等原因而被迫做某事的状态。
example_zh: 做某事的义务，您没有任何义务购买任何东西。

definition: the act of watching somebody/something carefully for a period of time, especially to learn something
example: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.
definition_zh: 指在一段时间内仔细观察某人或某物，尤其是为了从中学习某些东西的行为
example_zh: 大部分信息是通过直接观察动物的行为收集的。

definition: to see or notice somebody/something
example: observe somebody/something, Have you observed any changes lately?
definition_zh: 看到或注意到某人/某物
example_zh: 观察某人/某事，你最近有没有注意到什么变化？

definition: a person who watches somebody/something
example: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
definition_zh: 指观察某人或某事的人
example_zh: 据目击者称，飞机起飞后不久便发生爆炸。

definition: a situation, an event, etc. that makes it difficult for you to do or achieve something
example: So far, we have managed to overcome all the obstacles that have been placed in our path.
definition_zh: 一种情况、事件等，会让你难以做某事或实现某事
example_zh: 到目前为止，我们已经成功克服了前路上所有设置的障碍。

definition: to get something, especially by making an effort
example: to obtain information/data/results
definition_zh: 为了得到某样东西，尤其是通过付出努力
example_zh: 获取信息/数据/结果

definition: sometimes but not often
example: We occasionally meet for a drink after work.
definition_zh: 有时，但并不常见
example_zh: 我们偶尔会在下班后聚一聚，喝点东西。

definition: a job or profession
example: Please state your name, age and occupation below.
definition_zh: 一份工作或职业
example_zh: 请在下方填写您的姓名、年龄和职业。

definition: to fill or use a space, an area or an amount of time
example: The bed seemed to occupy most of the room.
definition_zh: 填满或利用一个空间、一个区域或一段时间
example_zh: 那张床似乎占据了房间的大部分空间。

definition: an illegal act
example: a criminal/serious/minor/sexual offence
definition_zh: 一种违法行为
example_zh: 刑事犯罪/严重犯罪/轻微犯罪/性犯罪

definition: to make somebody feel upset because of something you say or do that is rude or embarrassing
example: They'll be offended if you don't go to their wedding.
definition_zh: 因自己说的话或做的事粗鲁或令人难堪，而让某人感到不快
example_zh: 如果你不去参加他们的婚礼，他们会不高兴的。

definition: a person who commits a crime
example: a persistent/serious/violent, etc. offender
definition_zh: 犯罪者
example_zh: 惯犯/重犯/暴力犯等

definition: rude in a way that causes somebody to feel upset or annoyed because it shows a lack of respect
example: offensive remarks
definition_zh: 一种会因缺乏尊重而导致他人感到不快或恼火的粗鲁行为
example_zh: 冒犯性言论

definition: a person who is in a position of authority in a large organization
example: She is the government official in charge of the project.
definition_zh: 在大型组织中担任领导职务的人
example_zh: 她是负责该项目的政府官员。

definition: continuing to exist or develop
example: an ongoing debate/discussion/process
definition_zh: 继续存在或发展
example_zh: 一场正在进行的辩论/讨论/进程

definition: a space or hole that somebody/something can pass through
example: We could see the stars through an opening in the roof.
definition_zh: 某人或某物可以穿过的一个空隙或孔洞
example_zh: 我们透过屋顶的一个开口看到了星星。

definition: without hiding any feelings, opinions or information
example: Can you talk openly about sex with your parents?
definition_zh: 不隐瞒任何情感、观点或信息
example_zh: 你能和父母坦率地谈论性吗？

definition: a dramatic work in which all or most of the words are sung to music; works of this type as an art form or entertainment
example: Puccini’s operas
definition_zh: 一种戏剧作品，其中全部或大部分台词都配以音乐演唱；此类作品作为一种艺术形式或娱乐形式
example_zh: 普契尼的歌剧

definition: to work in a particular way
example: Most domestic freezers operate at below −18°C.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式运作
example_zh: 大多数家用冷冻柜的工作温度低于−18°C。

definition: a person who operates equipment or a machine
example: a computer/machine operator
definition_zh: 操作设备或机器的人
example_zh: 计算机/机器操作员

definition: a person that you are playing or fighting against in a game, competition, argument, etc.
example: a political opponent
definition_zh: 在游戏、比赛、争论等场合中，与你对战或对抗的人。
example_zh: 一位政治对手

definition: to disagree strongly with somebody’s plan, policy, etc. and try to change it or prevent it from succeeding
example: oppose somebody/something, This party would bitterly oppose the re-introduction of the death penalty.
definition_zh: 对某人的计划、政策等表示强烈反对，并试图加以改变或阻止其成功
example_zh: 反对某人/某事，该党将坚决反对恢复死刑。

definition: disagreeing strongly with something and trying to stop it
example: opposed to something, He was strongly opposed to modernism in art.
definition_zh: 对某事表示强烈反对并试图阻止它
example_zh: 反对某事，他强烈反对艺术中的现代主义。

definition: the act of strongly disagreeing with somebody/something, especially with the aim of preventing something from happening
example: Opposition came primarily from students.
definition_zh: 对某人或某事表示强烈反对的行为，尤其是为了阻止某事发生
example_zh: 反对声主要来自学生。

definition: expecting good things to happen or something to be successful; showing this feeling
example: We are now taking a more optimistic view.
definition_zh: 期待好事发生或某事取得成功；表现出这种心情
example_zh: 我们现在持更乐观的态度。

definition: a large group of people who play various musical instruments together, led by a conductor
example: She plays the flute in the school orchestra.
definition_zh: 由一名指挥家带领、共同演奏各种乐器的庞大乐团
example_zh: 她在学校管弦乐团里吹长笛。

definition: a part of the body that has a particular purpose, such as the heart or the brain; part of a plant with a particular purpose
example: the internal organs
definition_zh: 身体中具有特定功能的部位，例如心脏或大脑；植物中具有特定功能的部位
example_zh: 内脏

definition: produced or practised without using artificial chemicals
example: organic cheese/vegetables/wine, etc.
definition_zh: 在不使用人工化学物质的情况下生产或进行
example_zh: 有机奶酪/蔬菜/葡萄酒等。

definition: the point from which something starts; the cause of something
example: origin of something, the origins of life on earth
definition_zh: 某事开始的起点；某事的原因
example_zh: 某事物的起源，地球上生命的起源

definition: used to state what the result would be if something did not happen or if the situation were different
example: My parents lent me the money. Otherwise, I couldn't have afforded the trip.
definition_zh: 用于说明如果某事没有发生或情况不同，结果会如何
example_zh: 这笔钱是我父母借给我的。要不然，我根本负担不起这次旅行。

definition: the result or effect of an action or event
example: The likely outcome is a compromise.
definition_zh: 某项行动或事件的结果或影响
example_zh: 最可能的结果是达成妥协。

definition: on the outside of something
example: the outer layers of the skin
definition_zh: 在某物的外面
example_zh: 皮肤的外层

definition: a set of clothes that you wear together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose
example: She was wearing an expensive new outfit.
definition_zh: 一套搭配穿着的衣服，尤其是为特定场合或目的而穿的
example_zh: 她身上穿了一套昂贵的新衣服。

definition: a description of the main facts or points involved in something
example: outline of something, This is a brief outline of the events.
definition_zh: 对某事所涉及的主要事实或要点的描述
example_zh: 某事的概要，这是对这些事件的简要概述。

definition: to give a description of the main facts or points involved in something
example: outline something, He outlined his plan to leave St. Petersburg.
definition_zh: 对某事涉及的主要事实或要点进行描述
example_zh: 概述某事，他概述了自己离开圣彼得堡的计划。

definition: the amount of something that a person, a machine or an organization produces
example: Manufacturing output has increased by 8 per cent.
definition_zh: 一个人、一台机器或一个组织所生产的某物的数量
example_zh: 制造业产出增长了8%。

definition: extremely good; excellent
example: an outstanding player/achievement/success
definition_zh: 非常好；极好
example_zh: 一位杰出的球员/一项杰出的成就/一次杰出的成功

definition: including all the things or people that are involved in a particular situation; general
example: There will be winners in each of three age groups, and one overall winner.
definition_zh: 包括与特定情况有关的所有事物或人员；总体而言
example_zh: 三个年龄组中每个组别都将产生一名获奖者，并设一名总冠军。

definition: including everything or everyone; in total
example: The company will invest $1.6m overall in new equipment.
definition_zh: 包括所有事物或所有人；总计
example_zh: 该公司将总计投资160万美元用于购置新设备。

definition: to succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem that has been preventing you from achieving something
example: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.
definition_zh: 成功应对或控制一个一直阻碍你实现某件事的问题
example_zh: 她克服了伤病，赢得了奥运会金牌。

definition: during or for the night
example: We stayed overnight in London after the theatre.
definition_zh: 当晚或整晚
example_zh: 看完戏后，我们在伦敦住了一晚。

definition: connected with foreign countries, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
example: The firm is expanding into overseas markets.
definition_zh: 与外国有联系，尤其是那些与贵国隔海相望的国家
example_zh: 该公司正在向海外市场拓展业务。

definition: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean
example: to live/work/go overseas
definition_zh: 指前往或位于外国，尤其是那些与本国隔海相望的国家
example_zh: 去国外生活/工作/旅行

definition: to have to pay somebody for something that you have already received or return money that you have borrowed
example: owe somebody something, She still owes her father £3 000.
definition_zh: 不得不为已经收到过的东西付钱，或者归还借来的钱
example_zh: 欠某人钱，她至今还欠她父亲3 000英镑。

definition: the fact of owning something
example: a growth in home ownership
definition_zh: 拥有某物的这一事实
example_zh: 住房拥有率的增长

definition: a chemical element. Oxygen is a gas that is present in air and water and is necessary for people, animals and plants to live.
example: The patient didn't seem to be getting enough oxygen.
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。氧气是一种气体，存在于空气和水中，是人类、动物和植物生存所必需的。
example_zh: 患者似乎缺氧了。

definition: the speed at which somebody/something walks, runs or moves
example: at a… pace, to set off at a steady/gentle/leisurely pace
definition_zh: 某人或某物行走、奔跑或移动的速度
example_zh: 以……的速度，以平稳/缓慢/悠闲的速度出发

definition: to walk up and down in a small area many times, especially because you are feeling nervous or angry
example: + adv./prep., She paced up and down outside the room.
definition_zh: 在狭小范围内来回踱步多次，尤其是因为感到紧张或生气
example_zh: + 副词/介词，她在那间房外面来回踱步。

definition: to put something into a box, bag, etc. to be sold or transported
example: package something, packaged food/goods
definition_zh: 将某物装入盒子、袋子等容器中，以便出售或运输
example_zh: 某物的包装，包装食品/商品

definition: a small container made of paper or card in which goods are packed for selling
example: a packet of biscuits/cigarettes/crisps
definition_zh: 一种由纸或纸板制成的小型容器，用于包装待售商品
example_zh: 一包饼干/香烟/薯片

definition: a straight tree with a mass of long leaves at the top, growing in tropical countries. There are several types of palm tree, some of which produce fruit.
example: a date palm
definition_zh: 一种树干笔直、顶端簇生长叶的树，生长在热带国家。棕榈树有几种类型，其中有些会结果。
example_zh: 一棵椰枣树

definition: a square or rectangular piece of wood, glass or metal that forms part of a larger surface such as a door or wall
example: One of the glass panels in the front door was cracked.
definition_zh: 一块方形或矩形的木头、玻璃或金属片，构成门或墙等较大表面的一部分
example_zh: 前门的一块玻璃板裂了。

definition: a sudden feeling of great fear that cannot be controlled and prevents you from thinking clearly
example: a moment of panic
definition_zh: 一种无法控制的、突然袭来的强烈恐惧感，使你无法清晰思考
example_zh: 一瞬间的惊慌

definition: a public celebration of a special day or event, usually with bands in the streets and decorated vehicles
example: the Lord Mayor’s parade
definition_zh: 为庆祝某个特殊的日子或活动而举行的公众庆祝活动，通常包括街头乐队表演和装饰一新的车辆
example_zh: 市长游行

definition: two or more lines that are parallel to each other are the same distance apart at every point
example: parallel lines
definition_zh: 两条或多条彼此平行的直线，在每个点处的距离都相等
example_zh: 平行线

definition: a person, a situation, an event, etc. that is very similar to another, especially one in a different place or time
example: These ideas have parallels in Freud's thought too.
definition_zh: 与另一个（尤其是发生在不同地点或不同时间）非常相似的人、情况、事件等
example_zh: 这些观点在弗洛伊德的思想中也有相似之处。

definition: the group of people who are elected to make and change the laws of a country
example: The German parliament is called the ‘Bundestag’.
definition_zh: 经选举产生、负责制定和修改国家法律的一群人
example_zh: 德国议会被称为“联邦议院”（Bundestag）。

definition: for part of the day or week in which people work
example: She's looking for a part-time job.
definition_zh: 人们工作的一天或一周中的部分时间
example_zh: 她在找一份兼职工作。

definition: a person who is taking part in an activity or event
example: The average age of study participants was 48 years.
definition_zh: 参加某项活动或事件的人
example_zh: 研究参与者的平均年龄为48岁。

definition: the act of taking part in an activity or event
example: a show with lots of audience participation
definition_zh: 参与某项活动或事件的行为
example_zh: 一场观众互动性很强的演出

definition: to some extent; not completely
example: Some people are unwilling to attend the classes partly because of the cost involved.
definition_zh: 在某种程度上；并非完全
example_zh: 有些人不愿意参加这些课程，部分原因在于所需的费用。

definition: the state of being a partner in business
example: to be in/to go into partnership
definition_zh: 作为商业合伙人的身份
example_zh: 建立/进入合伙关系

definition: a long narrow area with walls on either side that connects one room or place with another
example: A dark narrow passage led to the main hall.
definition_zh: 一条长而窄的通道，两侧有墙壁，将一个房间或场所与另一个连接起来
example_zh: 一条昏暗狭窄的通道通向主厅。

definition: having or showing strong feelings of sexual love or of anger, etc.
example: to have a passionate nature
definition_zh: 怀有或表现出强烈的性爱或愤怒等情感。
example_zh: 天性热情

definition: a series of letters, numbers, etc. that you must type into a computer or computer system in order to be able to use it
example: Enter a username and password to get into the system.
definition_zh: 一系列字母、数字等，您必须将其输入计算机或计算机系统中，才能使用该系统
example_zh: 请输入用户名和密码以登录系统。

definition: the ability to stay calm and accept a delay or something annoying without complaining
example: She has little patience with (= will not accept or consider) such views.
definition_zh: 能够保持冷静，在遇到延误或令人不快的事情时不抱怨地接受
example_zh: 她对这种观点几乎毫无耐心（= 不会接受或考虑）。

definition: able to wait for a long time or accept annoying behaviour or difficulties without becoming angry
example: You'll just have to be patient and wait till I'm finished.
definition_zh: 能够长时间等待，或在不发怒的情况下容忍令人讨厌的行为或困难
example_zh: 你只能耐心点，等我做完再说。

definition: a period of time during which somebody stops talking or stops what they are doing
example: There was a long pause before she answered.
definition_zh: 某人停止说话或停止正在做的事情的一段时间
example_zh: 她沉默了许久才回答。

definition: to stop talking or doing something for a short time before continuing
example: Anita paused for a moment, then said: ‘All right’.
definition_zh: 暂时停止说话或做某事，然后继续
example_zh: 安妮塔停顿了一会儿，然后说：“好吧。”

definition: a person who is the same age or who has the same social status as you
example: She enjoys the respect of her peers.
definition_zh: 与你同龄或社会地位相同的人
example_zh: 她在同行中备受尊敬。

definition: a punishment for breaking a law, rule or contract
example: to impose a penalty
definition_zh: 因违反法律、规则或合同而受到的处罚
example_zh: 处以罚款

definition: an amount of money paid regularly to somebody when they retire from work
example: She receives a monthly pension.
definition_zh: 某人退休后定期领取的一笔款项
example_zh: 她每月领取一笔养老金。

definition: to understand or think of somebody/something in a particular way
example: perceive somebody/something/yourself (as something), This discovery was perceived as a major breakthrough.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式理解或看待某人/某事
example_zh: 将某人/某物/自己视为（某物），这一发现被视为一项重大突破。

definition: an idea, a belief or an image you have as a result of how you see or understand something
example: a campaign to change public perception of the police
definition_zh: 你对某事物的看法或理解所形成的想法、信念或印象
example_zh: 一项旨在改变公众对警察看法的宣传活动

definition: lasting for a long time or for all time in the future; existing all the time
example: She was unable to find a permanent job.
definition_zh: 在未来持续很长时间或永远；始终存在
example_zh: 她没能找到一份长期工作。

definition: in a way that lasts for a long time or for all time in the future; in a way that exists all the time
example: The stroke left his right side permanently damaged.
definition_zh: 以一种能够长期持续或在未来永远持续的方式；以一种始终存在的方式
example_zh: 中风导致他的右侧身体永久性受损。

definition: an official document that gives somebody the right to do something, especially for a limited period of time
example: a parking/building permit
definition_zh: 一份赋予某人某项权利的官方文件，尤其是指在限定时间内有效的文件
example_zh: 停车/建筑许可证

definition: to allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen
example: be permitted, Mobile phones are not permitted in the examination room.
definition_zh: 允许某人做某事，或允许某事发生
example_zh: 允许，考场内不允许携带手机。

definition: a particular attitude towards something; a way of thinking about something
example: a global perspective
definition_zh: 对某事的一种特定态度；思考某事的一种方式
example_zh: 全球视角

definition: a stage in a process of change or development
example: during the initial/final phase
definition_zh: 变革或发展过程中的一个阶段
example_zh: 在初期/末期

definition: a fact or an event in nature or society, especially one that is not fully understood
example: cultural/natural phenomena
definition_zh: 自然界或社会中的一种现象或事件，尤其是尚未被完全理解的
example_zh: 文化/自然现象

definition: the study of the nature and meaning of the universe and of human life
example: philosophy of something, the philosophy of science
definition_zh: 对宇宙及人类生命的本质与意义的研究
example_zh: 某事的哲学，科学哲学

definition: an act of choosing something
example: Take your pick (= choose).
definition_zh: 一种选择某物的行为
example_zh: 任选其一（= 选择）。

definition: to imagine somebody/something; to create an image of somebody/something in your mind
example: picture somebody/something, I could picture the scene clearly.
definition_zh: 想象某人/某物；在脑海中构想出某人/某物的形象
example_zh: 想象某人/某物，我能清晰地想象出那个场景。

definition: a number of things that have been placed on top of each other
example: pile of something, a pile of clothes/paper
definition_zh: 一些堆叠在一起的东西
example_zh: 一堆什么东西，一堆衣服/纸张

definition: to put things one on top of another; to form a pile
example: pile something, She piled the boxes one on top of the other.
definition_zh: 将东西一层层堆叠起来；堆成一堆
example_zh: 堆放某物，她把箱子一个接一个地堆叠起来。

definition: a small flat round piece of medicine that you swallow whole, without biting it
example: a vitamin pill
definition_zh: 一种小而扁平的圆形药片，需整片吞服，不要咀嚼
example_zh: 一粒维生素片

definition: an area of ground specially prepared and marked for playing a sports game
example: a football pitch
definition_zh: 为进行体育比赛而专门准备并划定的一块场地
example_zh: 一个足球场

definition: used to show that you are disappointed about something
example: a pity (that…), It's a pity that you can't stay longer.
definition_zh: 用于表达对某事感到失望
example_zh: 真可惜（……），真可惜你不能多待一会儿。

definition: the act of finding somebody a suitable job or place to live
example: a job placement service
definition_zh: 为某人寻找合适的工作或住所的行为
example_zh: 一项就业安置服务

definition: not decorated or complicated; simple
example: a plain but elegant dress
definition_zh: 不花哨，也不复杂；简单
example_zh: 一条简约而优雅的连衣裙

definition: to make a secret plan to harm somebody, especially a government or its leader
example: plot with somebody, It is claimed he plotted with the country's enemies.
definition_zh: 密谋加害某人，尤其是政府或其领导人
example_zh: 与某人密谋，据称他与该国的敌人密谋。

definition: used after a number to show that the real number or amount is more than the one mentioned
example: The work will cost £10 000 plus.
definition_zh: 用于数字之后，表示该实际数值或数量大于所提到的那个数值
example_zh: 这项工程的费用将超过10 000英镑。

definition: used to add more information
example: I've got too much on at work. Plus my father is not well.
definition_zh: 用于添加更多信息
example_zh: 我手头的工作太多了。而且我父亲身体不太好。

definition: an advantage; a good thing
example: Knowledge of French is a plus in her job.
definition_zh: 优势；好处
example_zh: 在她的工作中，会说法语是一大优势。

definition: having a sharp end
example: a pointed chin
definition_zh: 有一个尖端
example_zh: 尖下巴

definition: the state of being liked, enjoyed or supported by a large number of people
example: the increasing popularity of cycling
definition_zh: 受到大量人群喜爱、欣赏或支持的状态
example_zh: 骑行日益流行

definition: one part of something larger
example: a substantial/significant portion of the population
definition_zh: 更大整体中的一部分
example_zh: 相当大一部分人口

definition: to create a threat, problem, etc. that has to be dealt with
example: to pose a threat/risk/challenge/danger
definition_zh: 制造一种必须加以应对的威胁、问题等
example_zh: 构成威胁/风险/挑战/危险

definition: to put somebody/something in a particular position
example: position somebody/something/yourself + adv./prep., She quickly positioned herself behind the desk.
definition_zh: 使某人/某物处于某种特定境地
example_zh: 将某人/某物/自己置于……位置 + 副词/介词，她迅速将自己置于办公桌后面。

definition: a good or useful quality or aspect
example: What are the positives and negatives of going this route?
definition_zh: 一种良好的或有用的品质或方面
example_zh: 走这条路有哪些利弊？

definition: to have or own something
example: He was charged with possessing a shotgun without a licence.
definition_zh: 拥有某物
example_zh: 他被指控在未取得许可证的情况下持有霰弹枪。

definition: that can develop into something or be developed in the future
example: potential customers/buyers/investors/clients
definition_zh: 未来可能发展成某种东西，或者在未来被开发出来
example_zh: 潜在客户/买家/投资者/客户

definition: the possibility of something happening or being developed or used
example: potential for something, the potential for change
definition_zh: 某事发生、被开发或被使用的可能性
example_zh: 某事的潜力，变革的潜力

definition: used to say that something may develop into something
example: a potentially dangerous situation
definition_zh: 常说某事可能会发展成另一件事
example_zh: 一种可能危及安全的状况

definition: to supply a machine or vehicle with the energy that makes it work
example: be powered (by something), The aircraft is powered by a jet engine.
definition_zh: 为机器或车辆提供使其运转所需的能量
example_zh: 由……提供动力，该飞机由喷气发动机提供动力。

definition: words that show that you approve of and admire somebody/something
example: The team coach singled out two players for special praise.
definition_zh: 表示你赞同并钦佩某人或某事的词语
example_zh: 球队教练特别表扬了两名球员。

definition: to say that you approve of and admire somebody/something
example: praise somebody/something, She praised his cooking.
definition_zh: 表示你赞同并钦佩某人或某事
example_zh: 称赞某人/某事，她称赞他的厨艺。

definition: to happen before something or come before something/somebody in order
example: the years preceding the war
definition_zh: 在某事之前发生，或在顺序上排在某事或某人之前
example_zh: 战前几年

definition: rare and worth a lot of money
example: a precious vase
definition_zh: 稀有且价值不菲
example_zh: 一只珍贵的花瓶

definition: clear and accurate
example: precise details/instructions/measurements
definition_zh: 清晰准确
example_zh: 具体细节/说明/尺寸

definition: exactly
example: They look precisely the same to me.
definition_zh: 正是如此
example_zh: 在我看来，它们看起来完全一样。

definition: if something is predictable, you know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like
example: a predictable result
definition_zh: 如果某件事是可预见的，你就事先知道它会发生，或者会是什么样子
example_zh: 意料之中的结果

definition: a greater interest in or desire for somebody/something than somebody/something else
example: It's a matter of personal preference.
definition_zh: 对某人/某事比对另一个人/另一件事更感兴趣或更渴望
example_zh: 这纯属个人喜好问题。

definition: having a baby or young animal developing inside her/its body
example: My wife is pregnant.
definition_zh: 体内正孕育着一个婴儿或幼崽
example_zh: 我妻子怀孕了。

definition: the act or process of getting ready for something or making something ready
example: food preparation
definition_zh: 为某事做准备或使某物做好准备的行为或过程
example_zh: 食物准备

definition: the fact of being in a particular place
example: He hardly seemed to notice my presence.
definition_zh: 身处某地的这一事实
example_zh: 他似乎几乎没注意到我的存在。

definition: to keep a particular quality, feature, etc.; to make sure that something is kept
example: He was anxious to preserve his reputation.
definition_zh: 保持某种特定的品质、特征等；确保某物得以保持
example_zh: 他急于维护自己的声誉。

definition: to fix the price of something at a particular level
example: be priced + adv./prep., The main courses are all reasonably priced.
definition_zh: 将某物的价格定在特定水平
example_zh: 价格为 + 副词/介词，主菜的价格都很合理。

definition: a feeling of being pleased or satisfied that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done something well or own something that other people admire
example: The sight of her son graduating filled her with pride.
definition_zh: 当你或与你有关的人做得很好，或者拥有了别人羡慕的东西时，所产生的一种高兴或满足的感觉
example_zh: 看到儿子毕业，她感到无比自豪。

definition: mainly
example: a course designed primarily for specialists
definition_zh: 主要是
example_zh: 一门主要面向专业人士开设的课程

definition: main; most important; basic
example: My prime concern is to protect my property.
definition_zh: 主要；最重要的；基本的
example_zh: 我最关心的就是保护我的财产。

definition: most important; main
example: The principal reason for this omission is lack of time.
definition_zh: 最重要的；主要的
example_zh: 造成这一遗漏的主要原因是时间不够。

definition: a moral rule or a strong belief that influences your actions
example: He has high moral principles.
definition_zh: 一种道德准则或一种坚定的信念，它会影响你的行为
example_zh: 他有着崇高的道德准则。

definition: letters, words, numbers, etc. that have been printed onto paper
example: The tiny print was hard to read without my glasses.
definition_zh: 印在纸上的字母、单词、数字等
example_zh: 不戴眼镜的话，那些小字很难看清。

definition: happening or existing before something else or before a particular time
example: Although not essential, some prior knowledge of statistics is desirable.
definition_zh: 发生或存在于某事之前，或发生或存在于某个特定时间之前
example_zh: 虽然并非必须，但具备一些统计学基础知识会有所帮助。

definition: something that you think is more important than other things and should be dealt with first
example: a high/low priority
definition_zh: 你认为比其他事情更重要、应该优先处理的事情
example_zh: 高/低优先级

definition: the state of being alone and not watched or interrupted by other people
example: She was longing for some peace and privacy.
definition_zh: 独自一人的状态，不受他人注视或打扰
example_zh: 她渴望一些宁静和独处的时间。

definition: how likely something is to happen
example: The probability is that prices will rise rapidly.
definition_zh: 某件事发生的概率有多大
example_zh: 价格很可能会迅速上涨。

definition: likely to happen, to exist or to be true
example: the probable cause/explanation/outcome
definition_zh: 可能发生、存在或属实
example_zh: 可能的原因/解释/结果

definition: a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way
example: emergency/safety/disciplinary procedures
definition_zh: 做某事的一种方式，尤其是通常或正确的方式
example_zh: 应急/安全/纪律程序

definition: to continue doing something that has already been started; to continue being done
example: We're not sure whether we still want to proceed with the sale.
definition_zh: 继续做已经开始的事情；继续进行
example_zh: 我们还不确定是否还想继续进行这笔交易。

definition: to deal with information or materials in a particular way to produce a result
example: The computer processes data quickly.
definition_zh: 以特定方式处理信息或材料，以产生某种结果
example_zh: 计算机处理数据的速度很快。

definition: things that have been made or grown, especially things connected with farming
example: The market is full of farm produce.
definition_zh: 人工制造或种植的物品，尤其是与农业相关的物品
example_zh: 市场上到处都是农产品。

definition: a person who does a job that needs special training and a high level of education
example: You need a professional to sort out your finances.
definition_zh: 从事需要特殊培训和较高教育水平的工作的人
example_zh: 你需要找一位专业人士来理清你的财务状况。

definition: the process of writing and testing computer programs
example: programming languages
definition_zh: 编写和测试计算机程序的过程
example_zh: 编程语言

definition: to improve or develop over a period of time; to make progress
example: The course allows students to progress at their own speed.
definition_zh: 在一段时间内得到改善或发展；取得进步
example_zh: 该课程允许学生按照自己的节奏学习。

definition: in favour of new ideas, modern methods and change
example: progressive schools
definition_zh: 支持新思路、现代方法和变革
example_zh: 进步学校

definition: to stop something from being done or used especially by law
example: prohibit something, a law prohibiting the sale of alcohol
definition_zh: 阻止某事被实施或使用，尤其是通过法律手段
example_zh: 禁止某事，一项禁止销售酒精饮料的法律

definition: to estimate what the size, cost or amount of something will be in the future based on what is happening now
example: be projected, A growth rate of 4 per cent is projected for next year.
definition_zh: 根据当前的情况，推测某事物未来将达到的规模、成本或数量
example_zh: 预计，明年的增长率预计为4%。

definition: showing signs of being good or successful
example: He was voted the most promising new actor for his part in the movie.
definition_zh: 表现出良好或成功的迹象
example_zh: 他因在该片中的表演而被评选为最有前途的新人演员。

definition: a move to a more important job or rank in a company or an organization
example: The new job is a promotion for him.
definition_zh: 在公司或组织内晋升至更重要的职位或级别
example_zh: 这份新工作对他来说是一次晋升。

definition: to make somebody decide to do something; to cause something to happen
example: prompt something, The discovery of the bomb prompted an increase in security.
definition_zh: 促使某人决定做某事；导致某事发生
example_zh: 促使……，炸弹的发现促使安保措施得到加强。

definition: information, documents, etc. that show that something is true
example: conclusive/definitive/scientific proof
definition_zh: 能够证明某事属实的资料、文件等
example_zh: 确凿的/确定的/科学的证据

definition: a part or share of a whole
example: Water covers a large proportion of the earth's surface.
definition_zh: 整体的一部分或份额
example_zh: 水覆盖了地球表面的大部分区域。

definition: a formal suggestion or plan; the act of making a suggestion
example: to submit/present/put forward a proposal
definition_zh: 正式的建议或计划；提出建议的行为
example_zh: 提交/提出/提出一项建议

definition: to suggest a plan, an idea, etc. for people to think about and decide on
example: propose something, The government proposed changes to the voting system.
definition_zh: 提出一个计划、一个想法等，供大家思考并做出决定
example_zh: 提出某项建议，政府提议对投票制度进行改革。

definition: the possibility that something will happen
example: prospect of something, There is no immediate prospect of peace.
definition_zh: 某事发生的可能性
example_zh: ……的前景，目前尚无实现和平的迹象。

definition: the act of protecting somebody/something; the state of being protected
example: protection against something, Wear clothes that provide adequate protection against the wind and rain.
definition_zh: 保护某人/某物的行为；受到保护的状态
example_zh: 防某物，穿能有效抵御风雨的衣服。

definition: a substance, found within all living things, that forms the structure of muscles, organs, etc. There are many different proteins and they are an essential part of what humans and animals eat to help them grow and stay healthy.
example: essential proteins and vitamins
definition_zh: 一种存在于所有生物体内的物质，构成肌肉、器官等的结构。蛋白质种类繁多，是人类和动物饮食中不可或缺的一部分，有助于它们的生长和保持健康。
example_zh: 必需蛋白质和维生素

definition: a person who makes a public protest
example: Thousands of protesters marched through the city.
definition_zh: 进行公开抗议的人
example_zh: 数千名抗议者在市内游行。

definition: connected with a person’s mind and the way in which it works
example: the psychological development of children
definition_zh: 与人的思维及其运作方式有关
example_zh: 儿童的心理发展

definition: a scientist who studies and is trained in psychology
example: to see a psychologist
definition_zh: 一位受过心理学专业训练并从事心理学研究的科学家
example_zh: 去看心理医生

definition: the scientific study of the mind and how it influences behaviour
example: clinical/educational/child/sport psychology
definition_zh: 对心灵及其如何影响行为的科学研究
example_zh: 临床心理学/教育心理学/儿童心理学/运动心理学

definition: the act of printing a book, a magazine, etc. and making it available to the public; a book, a magazine, etc. that has been published
example: specialist publications
definition_zh: 将书籍、杂志等印制出来并向公众发行的行为；已经出版的书籍、杂志等
example_zh: 专业出版物

definition: the attention that is given to somebody/something by newspapers, television, etc.
example: good/bad/adverse publicity
definition_zh: 报纸、电视等对某人或某事给予的关注。
example_zh: 正面/负面/不良宣传

definition: the profession or business of preparing and printing books, magazines, CD-ROMs, etc. and selling or making them available to the public
example: a job in publishing
definition_zh: 指制作和印刷书籍、杂志、光盘等，并将其出售或提供给公众的职业或业务
example_zh: 出版行业的工作

definition: a type of loud and aggressive rock music popular in the late 1970s and early 1980s
example: a punk band
definition_zh: 一种在20世纪70年代末和80年代初流行的、声音洪亮且充满攻击性的摇滚音乐
example_zh: 一支朋克乐队

definition: a person who is being taught, especially a child in a school
example: school pupils
definition_zh: 正在接受教育的人，尤其是学校里的孩子
example_zh: 中小学生

definition: the act or process of buying something
example: to make a purchase (= buy something)
definition_zh: 购买某物的行为或过程
example_zh: 进行购买（=买东西）

definition: to buy something
example: purchase something, Please ensure that you purchase your ticket in advance.
definition_zh: 买点东西
example_zh: 购买商品时，请务必提前购票。

definition: not mixed with anything else; with nothing added
example: pure gold
definition_zh: 未与其他任何物质混合；未添加任何成分
example_zh: 纯金

definition: only; completely
example: I saw the letter purely by chance.
definition_zh: 仅；完全
example_zh: 我纯属偶然看到了那封信。

definition: to do something or try to achieve something over a period of time
example: to pursue a goal
definition_zh: 在一段时间内做某事或努力实现某事
example_zh: 追求一个目标

definition: the act of looking for or trying to get something
example: pursuit of something, the pursuit of happiness/knowledge/profit
definition_zh: 寻找或试图获得某物的行为
example_zh: 对某事的追求，对幸福/知识/利润的追求

definition: a game, etc. that you have to think about carefully in order to answer it or do it
example: a crossword puzzle
definition_zh: 一种游戏等，需要仔细思考才能回答或完成
example_zh: 一道填字游戏

definition: a written list of questions that are answered by a number of people so that information can be collected from the answers
example: (British English), to fill in a questionnaire
definition_zh: 一份书面问题清单，由多人回答这些问题，以便从答案中收集信息
example_zh: (英国英语)，填写一份问卷

definition: happening or existing between people of different races
example: racial hatred/prejudice/tension/violence
definition_zh: 发生在不同种族的人之间，或存在于不同种族的人之间
example_zh: 种族仇恨/偏见/紧张局势/暴力

definition: the unfair treatment of people who belong to a different race; violent behaviour towards them
example: a victim of racism
definition_zh: 对不同种族的人的不公平对待；针对他们的暴力行为
example_zh: 种族歧视的受害者

definition: having the belief that some races of people are better than others or having general beliefs about other people based only on their race; showing this through violent or unfair treatment of people of other races
example: racist attitudes/remarks
definition_zh: 认为某些种族优于其他种族，或仅凭种族就对他人抱有普遍偏见；并通过暴力或不公正对待其他种族的人来表现这种态度
example_zh: 种族主义态度/言论

definition: a person who believes that some races of people are better than others or who has general beliefs about other people based only on their race, and may show this in violent or unfair treatment of people of other races
example: He's a racist.
definition_zh: 指认为某些种族优于其他种族，或仅凭种族就对他人抱有普遍偏见，并可能通过对其他种族的人施加暴力或不公正对待来表现这种态度的人
example_zh: 他是个种族主义者。

definition: powerful and very dangerous rays that are sent out from radioactive substances
example: high levels/doses of radiation that damage cells
definition_zh: 放射性物质释放出的强大且极其危险的射线
example_zh: 高水平/高剂量的辐射会损伤细胞

definition: a wooden or metal bar placed around something as a barrier or to provide support
example: She leaned on the ship's rail and gazed out to sea.
definition_zh: 一种木制或金属制的横杆，用于围绕某物作为屏障或提供支撑
example_zh: 她倚在船舷上，凝望着大海。

definition: done, chosen, etc. without somebody deciding in advance what is going to happen, or without any regular pattern
example: the random killing of innocent people
definition_zh: 在没有事先有人决定将发生什么，或者没有任何固定规律的情况下，就完成了、选定了等
example_zh: 对无辜民众的随意杀戮

definition: to vary between two particular amounts, sizes, etc., including others between them
example: range from A to B, Accommodation ranges from tourist class to luxury hotels.
definition_zh: 在两个特定的数值、尺寸等之间变化，包括介于两者之间的其他数值、尺寸等
example_zh: 范围从A到B，住宿类型从旅游级酒店到豪华酒店不等。

definition: the position, especially a high position, that somebody has in a particular organization, society, etc.
example: She was not used to mixing with people of high social rank.
definition_zh: 某人在特定组织、社会等中所处的职位，尤其是高位。
example_zh: 她不习惯与社会地位较高的人打交道。

definition: to give somebody/something a particular position on a scale according to quality, importance, success, etc.; to have a position of this kind
example: rank somebody/something, In most Australian elections, electors are required to rank all candidates.
definition_zh: 根据质量、重要性、成功程度等因素，将某人或某物在某种标准上排在特定位置；处于这种位置
example_zh: 对某人/某事进行排序。在澳大利亚的大多数选举中，选民必须对所有候选人进行排序。

definition: happening quickly or in a short period of time
example: rapid change/expansion/growth/development
definition_zh: 发生得很快或在短时间内发生
example_zh: 快速变化/扩张/增长/发展

definition: very quickly; at a great rate
example: to increase/spread/expand rapidly
definition_zh: 非常快；速度极快
example_zh: 迅速增加/扩散/扩展

definition: a small animal with a long tail, that looks like a large mouse, usually considered a pest (= an animal which is disliked because it destroys food or spreads disease)
example: rat poison
definition_zh: 一种尾巴很长的小动物，看起来像一只大老鼠，通常被视为害虫（即因破坏食物或传播疾病而令人讨厌的动物）
example_zh: 老鼠药

definition: to have or think that somebody/something has a particular level of quality, value, etc.
example: rate somebody/something + adv./prep., The university is highly rated for its research.
definition_zh: 指某人或某物具有某种特定的质量、价值等水平，或认为其具有这种水平。
example_zh: 评价某人/某事 + 副词/介词，该大学因其研究而备受好评。

definition: a measurement of how good, popular, important, etc. somebody/something is, especially in relation to other people or things
example: The poll gave an approval rating of 39 per cent for the president.
definition_zh: 衡量某人或某事物在质量、受欢迎程度、重要性等方面表现如何的标准，尤其是相对于其他人或事物而言
example_zh: 该民调显示，总统的支持率为39%。

definition: not cooked
example: raw meat
definition_zh: 未煮熟
example_zh: 生肉

definition: the distance over which you can stretch your arms to touch something; the distance over which a particular object can be used to touch something else
example: beyond somebody's reach, The shot was well beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
definition_zh: 你伸直双臂能够触碰到某物的距离；利用某个特定物体能够触碰到另一物的距离
example_zh: 超出了某人的触及范围，那记射门完全超出了守门员的触及范围。

definition: accepting in a sensible way what it is actually possible to do or achieve in a particular situation
example: a realistic assessment/approach/view
definition_zh: 以理智的方式接受在特定情况下实际上能够做或实现的事情
example_zh: 一种切合实际的评估/方法/观点

definition: fair, practical, and sensible
example: it is reasonable to do something, It is reasonable to assume that he knew beforehand that this would happen.
definition_zh: 公平、务实、明智
example_zh: 做某事是合理的，可以合理地推测他事先就知道会发生这种情况。

definition: to a degree that is fairly good but not very good
example: The instructions are reasonably straightforward.
definition_zh: 程度还算不错，但算不上非常好
example_zh: 说明相当简单明了。

definition: to build or put something together again
example: After the earthquake, the people set about rebuilding their homes.
definition_zh: 重新组装或拼装某物
example_zh: 地震过后，人们便着手重建家园。

definition: to remember something
example: recall something, She could not recall his name.
definition_zh: 记住某事
example_zh: 她想起了些什么，却想不起他的名字。

definition: the part of a phone that you hold close to your mouth and ear
example: to pick up/lift/put down/replace the receiver
definition_zh: 手机中贴近嘴和耳朵的那部分
example_zh: 拿起/挂起/放下/放回听筒

definition: a difficult time for the economy of a country, when there is less trade and industrial activity than usual and more people are unemployed
example: How do you assess the impact of the current recession on manufacturing?
definition_zh: 一个国家经济陷入困境的时期，此时贸易和工业活动比平时减少，失业人数增加
example_zh: 您如何评估当前经济衰退对制造业的影响？

definition: to think something or have an opinion about something
example: I reckon (that) I’m going to get that job.
definition_zh: 对某事有所思考或持有某种看法
example_zh: 我估计（我）会得到那份工作。

definition: the act of remembering who somebody is when you see them, or of identifying what something is
example: He glanced briefly towards her but there was no sign of recognition.
definition_zh: 看到某人时想起他是谁，或者辨认出某物是什么的行为
example_zh: 他朝她瞥了一眼，但她脸上丝毫没有认出他的神色。

definition: to get well again after being ill, hurt, etc.
example: recover from something, He's still recovering from his operation.
definition_zh: 在生病、受伤等之后恢复健康。
example_zh: 从……中恢复过来，他仍在从手术中恢复。

definition: the process of becoming well again after an illness or injury
example: My father has made a full recovery from the operation.
definition_zh: 患病或受伤后逐渐康复的过程
example_zh: 我父亲已经从手术中完全康复了。

definition: a person who has recently joined the armed forces or the police
example: the training of new recruits
definition_zh: 刚加入武装部队或警察部队的人
example_zh: 新兵的培训

definition: to find new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.
example: recruit (somebody), We are trying to recruit officers from more diverse backgrounds.
definition_zh: 为公司、组织、武装部队等招募新成员。
example_zh: 招聘（某人），我们正致力于从更多元化的背景中招聘管理人员。

definition: the act or process of finding new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.
example: the recruitment of new members
definition_zh: 为公司、组织、武装部队等招募新成员的行为或过程。
example_zh: 新成员的招募

definition: an act of making something less or smaller; the state of being made less or smaller
example: Some staff received wage rises, while others experienced a reduction.
definition_zh: 使某物减少或变小的行为；被减少或变小的状态
example_zh: 部分员工的工资有所上涨，而另一些员工的工资则有所下降。

definition: the official who controls the game in some sports
example: He was sent off for arguing with the referee.
definition_zh: 某些体育项目中负责掌控比赛的官员
example_zh: 他因与裁判争执而被红牌罚下。

definition: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons
example: There has been a steady flow of refugees from the war zone.
definition_zh: 因战争或出于政治、宗教或社会原因而被迫离开本国或家园的人
example_zh: 来自战区的难民一直源源不断地涌入。

definition: attention to or thought and care for somebody/something
example: regard for somebody/something, to have scant/little/no regard for somebody/something
definition_zh: 对某人或某事的关注、思虑和关怀
example_zh: 尊重某人/某事，对某人/某事几乎不尊重/不太尊重/完全不尊重

definition: to think about somebody/something in a particular way
example: regard somebody/something + adv./prep., They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式看待某人/某事
example_zh: 将……视为…… + 副词/介词，他们对镇外的人心存疑虑。

definition: of or relating to a region
example: services available at a local and regional level
definition_zh: 指某地区或与某地区有关的
example_zh: 在地方和区域层面提供的服务

definition: an official list or record of names, items, etc.; a book that contains such a list
example: The bride and groom signed the register.
definition_zh: 关于姓名、项目等的正式清单或记录；收录此类清单的书籍
example_zh: 新郎和新娘在登记簿上签了名。

definition: to record your/somebody’s/something’s name on an official list
example: You can also register online.
definition_zh: 将您/某人/某物的姓名登记在正式名单上
example_zh: 您也可以在线注册。

definition: the act of making an official record of something/somebody
example: the registration of letters and parcels
definition_zh: 对某事或某人进行正式记录的行为
example_zh: 信件和包裹的登记

definition: a sad feeling because of something that has happened or something that you have done or not done
example: a feeling/pang/twinge of regret
definition_zh: 因某件事的发生，或是自己做过或没做过某事而产生的悲伤情绪
example_zh: 一丝/一阵/一缕的遗憾

definition: to feel sorry about something you have done or about something that you have not been able to do
example: regret something, If you don't do it now, you'll only regret it.
definition_zh: 对自己做过的事或没能做到的事情感到遗憾
example_zh: 后悔某事，如果你现在不做，将来只会后悔。

definition: to control something by means of rules
example: The department is responsible for regulating the insurance industry.
definition_zh: 通过规则来控制某事
example_zh: 该部门负责监管保险业。

definition: an official rule made by a government or some other authority
example: too many rules and regulations
definition_zh: 由政府或其他机构制定的正式规定
example_zh: 规则和条例太多了

definition: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger
example: The experience reinforced my sense of loss.
definition_zh: 使一种感觉、一种想法等更加强烈
example_zh: 这次经历加深了我的失落感。

definition: to a fairly large degree, especially in comparison to something else
example: relatively large/small/high/low
definition_zh: 在相当大的程度上，尤其是与其他事物相比
example_zh: 相对大/小/高/低

definition: closely connected with the subject you are discussing or the situation you are in
example: relevant information/facts/documents/factors
definition_zh: 与你正在讨论的话题或所处的状况密切相关
example_zh: 相关信息/事实/文件/因素

definition: the feeling of happiness that you have when something unpleasant stops or does not happen
example: I felt a huge sense of relief when I heard they were all OK.
definition_zh: 当某件不愉快的事情停止或没有发生时，你所感受到的幸福感
example_zh: 听说他们都平安无事，我感到如释重负。

definition: to remove or reduce an unpleasant feeling or pain
example: to relieve the symptoms of a cold
definition_zh: 消除或减轻不适感或疼痛
example_zh: 缓解感冒症状

definition: feeling happy because something unpleasant has stopped or has not happened; showing this
example: She sounded relieved.
definition_zh: 因为某件不愉快的事情已经停止或没有发生而感到高兴；表现出这种情绪
example_zh: 她听起来松了一口气。

definition: to need or depend on somebody or something
example: Many people rely on public transport.
definition_zh: 需要或依赖某人或某物
example_zh: 许多人依赖公共交通。

definition: something that you say or write which expresses an opinion, a thought, etc. about somebody/something
example: to make a remark
definition_zh: 你所说或所写的内容，用来表达对某人或某事的观点、想法等。
example_zh: 发表评论

definition: to say or write a comment about something/somebody
example: Sport, George Orwell once remarked, is like war.
definition_zh: 对某事或某人发表评论或写下评论
example_zh: 乔治·奥威尔曾说过，体育就像战争。

definition: unusual or surprising in a way that causes people to take notice
example: a remarkable achievement/career/talent
definition_zh: 以某种不同寻常或出人意料的方式引起人们的注意
example_zh: 一项非凡的成就/职业生涯/才华

definition: in a way that is unusual or surprising and causes people to take notice
example: The car is in remarkably good condition for its age.
definition_zh: 以一种不同寻常或出人意料的方式，引起人们的注意
example_zh: 以这辆车的车龄而言，它的状况出奇地好。

definition: the presenting of and writing about news on television and radio, and in newspapers
example: accurate/balanced/objective reporting
definition_zh: 在电视、广播和报纸上播报和报道新闻
example_zh: 准确、公正、客观的报道

definition: typical of a particular group of people; that is a typical example of something
example: Is a questionnaire answered by 500 people truly representative of the population as a whole?
definition_zh: 具有某一群体的典型特征；那是某事物的典型例子
example_zh: 由500人填写的问卷真的能代表整个人口吗？

definition: a person who has been chosen to speak or vote for somebody else or for a group of people, or to take the place of somebody else
example: Our elected representatives in government should be doing something about this.
definition_zh: 受选代表他人或某群体发言、投票，或代替他人的人
example_zh: 政府中的民选代表应该对此采取一些措施。

definition: the opinion that people have about what somebody/something is like, based on what has happened in the past
example: to have a good/bad reputation
definition_zh: 人们根据过去发生的事情，对某人或某事所形成的看法
example_zh: 声誉良好/不佳

definition: something that you need or want
example: the basic requirements of life
definition_zh: 你需要或想要的东西
example_zh: 生活的基本需求

definition: the act of saving somebody/something from a dangerous or difficult situation; the fact of being saved
example: We had given up hope of rescue.
definition_zh: 将某人或某物从危险或困境中解救出来的行为；被解救的事实
example_zh: 我们已经对获救不抱希望了。

definition: to save somebody/something from a dangerous or harmful situation
example: rescue somebody/something from something/somebody, The coastguard rescued six people from the sinking boat.
definition_zh: 将某人或某物从危险或有害的处境中解救出来
example_zh: 从……中救出某人/某物，海岸警卫队从沉没的船上救出了六人。

definition: a supply of something that is available to be used in the future or when it is needed
example: cash/foreign currency reserves
definition_zh: 指可供将来或需要时使用的某种物资储备
example_zh: 现金/外汇储备

definition: to ask for a seat, table, room, etc. to be available for you or somebody else at a future time
example: reserve something for somebody/something, I'd like to reserve a table for three for eight o'clock.
